title: POST <join link> answer, not 200
description: Every refusal, by status: 400 `bad_request` or `too_large` (not a device describing itself), 404 `unknown_code`, 410 `used` or `expired` (also a code whose app was switched off for the account), 409 `version` (with the `v` the server speaks), 429 `too_many_attempts` (wrong codes from one address). A device decides by the status alone; the body is for people and logs.
